entities.name: chocolate banana ice cream recipe
entities.summary: Chocolate Banana Ice Cream is a healthy and easy dessert recipe. It includes 4 frozen ripe bananas, 2 tablespoons of unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 tablespoon of honey or maple syrup (optional), 1/4 teaspoon of vanilla extract, 1/4 teaspoon of salt, and 1/4 cup of milk (dairy or non-dairy). The ingredients are blended in a food processor until smooth and creamy, then frozen for 3-4 hours. Before serving, the ice cream is left to soften for 5-10 minutes and can be topped with chopped nuts, fresh fruit, or chocolate chips. The recipe can also be customized with flavors like peanut butter, strawberry, or caramel.

entities.name: classic spaghetti carbonara recipe
entities.summary: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara is a fun, easy, and tasty recipe. It includes 1 pound of spaghetti, 6 slices of thick-cut bacon, 1 cup of freshly grated Parmesan cheese, 3 large eggs, 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil, and salt and pepper. The spaghetti is cooked in salted boiling water, while the bacon is sautéed until crispy. The eggs and Parmesan are whisked together, then combined with the spaghetti and bacon in a pot. Reserved pasta water is added to create a creamy sauce. The dish is seasoned with salt and pepper and served immediately.

entities.name: creamy tomato basil soup recipe
entities.summary: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup is an easy and cozy recipe that takes about 30 minutes to prepare. It includes 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 diced onion, 1 can of crushed tomatoes, 2 cups of vegetable broth, 1/2 cup of heavy cream, 2-3 tablespoons of chopped fresh basil, salt and pepper, and croutons or bread for serving. The soup is made by sautéing garlic and onion, adding crushed tomatoes and broth, simmering, pureeing, and then adding cream and basil. It is served with croutons or bread and can be customized with additional ingredients like mushrooms or red peppers.

entities.name: cross-validation
entities.summary: Cross-validation is a technique used in machine learning to evaluate model performance and tune hyperparameters. It involves splitting the dataset into k folds, training the model on k-1 folds, and validating it on the remaining fold. This process is repeated k times, with each fold serving as the validation set once. The average performance metric across all folds is calculated to provide a more accurate estimate of the model's true performance. Cross-validation helps avoid overfitting and is useful for hyperparameter tuning by comparing different models and selecting the best hyperparameters. Variations include leave-one-out, stratified, and nested cross-validation, each suited to different dataset sizes and modeling goals.

entities.name: seitan
entities.summary: Seitan is a meat substitute made from wheat gluten with a chewy, meat-like texture. It is an excellent source of protein and can be used in various dishes, such as seitan "meatball" subs, seitan stir-fry with vegetables, and seitan "chick'n" Parmesan. When cooking with seitan, press and drain excess liquid to prevent sogginess, and marinate or season it before cooking to enhance flavor. Experiment with different seasonings and spices to find preferred flavors. Seitan can often replace meat in recipes.
